question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Advantages
solution:
The correct answer is: **Minuses.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Advantages"** means benefits or favorable circumstances that enhance the chances of success or effectiveness. (लाभ)

 
 
• **Example: **Having a good education is one of the greatest advantages in life.
 
 
 
• **"Minuses"** refers to disadvantages or negative aspects of a situation. (नुकसान)
 
 
• **Example: **The minuses of living in a big city include high cost of living and traffic congestion.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Advantages'** is **'Minuses'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Minuses**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Adjourns** (स्थगित करना): To suspend proceedings to another time or place.

 
 
• **Example:** The meeting was adjourned until the following week.
 
 
 
• **Refuges** (शरण): A place of safety or shelter.
 
 
• **Example: **The refugees found refuge in a neighboring country.
 
 
 
• **Boons** (वरदान): Blessings or beneficial things.
 
 
• **Example:** The new technology has been a boon to the industry.
